clips.title: The story
paras: Gelbin Mekkatorque is the High Tinker of the gnomes, currently residing in exile in Tinker Town within Ironforge. Renowned as a visionary engineer whose inventions include the mechanostrider and the Deeprun Tram, he now carries the heavy burden of Gnomeregan's fall and oversees efforts to reclaim his people's ancestral home.

Gnomish leadership is earned through intellect and merit rather than bloodlines, and Gelbin Mekkatorque's rise to High Tinker was propelled by pure inventive genius. Mekkatorque revolutionized personal transportation with the creation of the first functioning mechanostrider. He also assisted the Bronzebeard dwarves in developing their formidable siege engines, and he was instrumental in the creation of the subterranean Deeprun Tram linking Ironforge to Stormwind.
